description: CAC's verdict on a proposed name, the same check fastcac.com's name checker runs: CAC's naming rules first, then CAC's own compliance and similarity engine. Returns `tone` (ok, caveat = a certificate is needed, blocked), a plain `message`, `code` (CAC's 00-14; none when one of CAC's naming rules blocked it), `similar_names`/`most_similar_name`/`similarity_score`, and `alternatives`: names to offer, each already passing the rules (for a name missing its ending, the name with each accepted ending: Ventures, Enterprises, Services, Concepts, Hub, Fashion, Beauty, Biz, or Limited/Ltd for a company). `line_of_business` must be one of CAC's entries; anything else returns error line_of_business_invalid with `choices` to ask about, never a guess. A name ending in Limited/Ltd/PLC is checked as a company unless `name_type` says otherwise. An `error` is never a verdict: say CAC didn't answer.

line_of_business.description: An exact entry from CAC's line-of-business picklist (search_line_of_business).

name_type.description: Optional: business name or company (Ltd). Inferred from the name's ending when left out.

name: check_business_name_compliance

outputSchema.description: CAC's verdict on the name, the same one fastcac.com's name checker gives.

alternatives.description: Names to offer instead, each already passing CAC's rules.

code.description: CAC's 00-14 code; null when one of CAC's naming rules blocked it.

line_of_business.description: The exact CAC entry the name was checked with.

message.description: The reason, in plain words, to show the person.

source.description: heuristics (CAC's naming rules) or bulkupload (CAC's engine).

tone.description: ok: CAC would accept it; caveat: accepted, but a certificate is needed; blocked: not accepted.

title: Run CAC's name compliance check
